sequences.name: Planter
abilities: Physical Enhancement: High physical strength.
Farming Proficiency: High proficiency with farming tools, distinguishing among different seeds, and nurturing them.
Weather Forecasting: Can predict the weather by observing clouds, wind, and other natural phenomena.

sequences.name: Doctor (Healing Pastor)
abilities: Spirituality: Enhanced Spirituality, allowing use of Spirit Vision.
Spirit Vision: Can discern a patient's health condition with precision.
Healing: Can heal most forms of physical and Soul injuries.
Surgical Mastery: Experts at surgery with fine control over medical tools.
Treatments: Various treatments for different injuries and illnesses.
Evil Ailment Treatment: Can relieve ailments associated with Evil and Depravity.
Disease Treatments: Can heal diseases not associated with Evil.
Trauma Treatment: Can effectively treat most forms of physical trauma.
Soul Suture (Soul Sewing): Can perform Soul level surgery to repair wounds.
Giving Life: Can gradually restore energy and strength of a weakened person.
Time Distinguishment: Can easily distinguish the time.

sequences.name: Harvest Priest
sequences.description: A bringer of fertility and growth, whose powers ensure abundance and bountiful harvests.
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Various enhancements, though not much.
Seed Catalyzation: Can catalyze life within seeds or plants to cause rapid growth.
Plant & Insect Commanding: Can command plants and insects within 30 meters.
Knowledge (Ritualistic Spells): Obtains Ritualistic Spells for manipulating weather.
Healing: Improved healing capabilities; can cure diseases in plants and land.

sequences.name: Biologist
abilities: Cross-breeding: Can create chimeras and Cross-breeds between various animals, plants, and objects.
Poison Creation: Body can produce highly potent toxins.
Knowledge (Life): Deep understanding of the characteristics of living organisms.

sequences.name: Druid
sequences.description: Druids are the favored of Nature, attendants of the oak, and are able to rely on plants and animals to accomplish various tasks.
abilities: Underground Travel: Can soften ground to sink and travel underground.
Wrath of Nature: Can make surrounding environment turn hostile against designated adversaries.
Swamp: Can turn ground into a Swamp to restrict movements.
Child of the Oak: Can create a layer of stone or wood skin for protection.
Golem Creation: Can create Stone Golems.
Animal Transformation: Can transform into giant bears or other creatures.
Cross-breeding: Enhanced ability to create Cross-breeds.
Seed Catalyzation: Enhanced; can cause mutated vines to grow at target location.
Poison Creation: Can throw strands of hair that combust and emit toxic substances.

sequences.name: Ancient Alchemist
abilities: Mutation: Can cause Mutations to spring up in target's body and mind.
Artificial Life Creation: Can create golems and ordinary humans using fragmented Souls.
Creature Commanding: Can control Beyonder creatures with low intelligence.
Life Aura: Can fill surroundings with vibrant Life force causing rapid growth.
Healing: Greatly enhanced healing abilities; can regenerate entire limbs.
Animal Transformation: Can transform into supernatural creatures without Godhood.
Cross-breeding: Cross-breeds can now possess a Soul.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Mythical Creature Form.

sequences.name: Pallbearer
sequences.description: The Pallbearer is an important component of the Mother Pathway's construction of the Cycle of Reality, thus linking it to the authorities of Death and Return.
abilities: Death & Return: Many abilities in the domain of Death and Earth representing Returning to the Earth.
Evil Spirit Transformation: Can transform the dead into Evil Spirits.
Life Deprivation: Each hit subjects target to a trial of Death.
Return to Earth: Can make Undead creatures quickly dissipate and Return to Earth.
Maternal Embrace: Can Seal away Undead Angels.
Artificial Life Creation: Can create Golems with Sequence 4 power from Soil or Clay.
Mythical Creature Form: Can respond to prayers.

sequences.name: Desolate Matriarch
abilities: Gender Transition: Advancing results in becoming female regardless of original gender.
Earth, Desolation, Harvest, & Life: Partial authority over Earth, Desolation, Harvest, and Life.
Desolation: Can cause all Life within 30 kilometers to drain away until Death.
Evil Spirit Transformation: Can turn dead humans into Evil Spirits.
Artificial Life Creation: Can create dolls and Golems from Soil, Plants, and Metals.
Mythical Creature Transformation: Can briefly transform into a Mythical Creature.
Life Deprivation: Each strike subjects target to trials of Losing Control and Death.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete mass of flesh and blood with reproductive organs, wheat, mushrooms, and vines.

sequences.name: Naturewalker
abilities: Nature & Mother: Partial authority over Nature and Mother.
Child of Nature: Can reshape environments and become one with Natural elements.
World Creation: Can nurture and conceive realms embodying the concept of Nature.

sequences.name: Mother
abilities: Mother: Authority derived from Mother of All symbolism; gives birth to all things.
Earth: Authority derived from Mother of All and Brood Hive of Filth.
Nature: Authority derived from Goddess of Origin symbolism; immense vitality.
Death: Partial authority over Death derived from Goddess of Origin and Brood Hive of Filth.
Life: Partial authority over Life derived from Mother of All and Goddess of Origin.
Bountiful Earth: Divine Kingdom filled with the Mother's definition of Nature, Life, and Death.
Return: Lower authority derived from Earth and Death; can create Cycle of Reincarnation.
Healing (Treatment): Lower authority originating from Mother and Life.
Desolation: Lower authority from Nature and Death.
Transmutation: Lower authority from Mother and Life.
Harvest: Lesser manifestation of Nature and Life.
